claims: The San Antonio Spurs played the Dallas Mavericks at home on Thursday, April 10, 2026.
The San Antonio Spurs won 139-120 against the Dallas Mavericks.
Victor Wembanyama led the San Antonio Spurs in the victory with 40 points and 13 rebounds.
The San Antonio Spurs' next game is against the Denver Nuggets on Sunday, April 12, 2026, at 7:30 PM CDT.
Local coverage is available on FanDuel Sports Network Southwest.
